answer: Every mesa's action capacity halves each epoch and can be refilled only by burning atlas, logged on the bridge, a shared ledger linking each mesa to its keys and funding wallets. Linked mesas collide there: refilling the k-th one costs k atlas, every epoch, forever. An honest mesa burns 1 atlas per epoch. A farm of 1,000 linked clones burns about 500,000 each epoch just to stay active, and if it stops paying, the clones decay to nothing. It breaks if the bridge misses links hidden behind fresh wallets.
